from pathlib import Path
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
for name in ('logo.svg', 'logo-reversed.svg'):
    path=Path(name)
    svg=path.read_text()
    def clean(match):
        data=re.sub(r'-?\\d+\\.\\d+',lambda n: f'{float(n[0]):.2f}'.rstrip('0').rstrip('.'),match[1])
        data=re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', data).strip()
        return 'd=\"'+data+'\"'
    svg=re.sub(r'd=\"(["'^"]+)"'"',clean,svg)
    path.write_text(svg)
for name in ('logo.svg','mark.svg','logo-reversed.svg'):
    root=ET.parse(name).getroot()
    assert root.attrib['viewBox']
    assert root.find('{http://www.w3.org/2000/svg}title') is not None
    assert not any(e.tag.rsplit('}',1)[-1] in ('text','image','script') for e in root.iter())
    print(name, Path(name).stat().st_size, 'bytes; valid SVG; no fonts or external assets')
